sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Your Car Needs a Service is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, soldier! He who has the information is the victor. You want peace to win, don't you? So it's time to find some information for the good guys. A company was laundering money in the car dealership. Find any data on them that might be useful. My man managed to get a copy of the key to the office. Here you go. The problem, though, is that the entrance to the section itself is also locked, and we haven't been able to find that second key."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain the digital storage device from the car dealership manager's office on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the storage device

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2x Military flash drive
- Unlocks purchase of M67 hand grenade at Peacekeeper LL3
"This information would be good leverage in the negotiations. It turns out that someone with the nickname Kaban was operating there during the attack. A sincere thank you from the Blue Helmets!"

In this quest you have to find a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found on a desk inside the LexOs car dealership director's office, which is located in the closed section on the second floor. A Car dealership closed section key is required to access the office, and the Car dealership director's office room key provided by Peacekeeper via in-game mail is required to open it.

Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores.
